results.title: Iddrisu Sulemana edges Clifford Braimah to become NPP Savannah Regional Chairman
results.description: Alhaji Iddrisu Sulemana has been elected Chairman of the New Patriotic Party (NPP) in the Savannah Region after narrowly defeating former Ghana Water Limited Managing Director Clifford Abdallah Braimah in the party’s regional executive elections.
